findings: Exports the exact public constant literal 8, result interface and two functions; no imports, consistent with the empty import set.
Validates length in JavaScript UTF-16 code units, exactly one non-leading at sign, nonempty allowed segments and case-preserving identity.

Uses the exact supplied stable-ID regex and compares each entire matched substring to its segment. This avoids accepting a final line terminator through native dollar-anchor behavior and satisfies the explicit prohibition on control characters.
Uses the exact supplied global Markdown-link regex, reset to lastIndex zero each call; the regex and accumulator are invocation-local.
Uses native input.matchAll and capture 1 then capture 2 then empty string, with no decoding, label inspection, source mutation or code/comment filtering.
Uses the exact supplied case-insensitive intent regex, requires exact lowercase plugin:// for acceptance, and counts every malformed intent occurrence.
Keeps only retained valid IDs in an invocation-local set, preserves first occurrence order, ignores retained duplicates and counts each valid dropped occurrence after the cap.
Constructs return fields in references, truncatedCount, invalidCount order; leaves native input errors uncaught; contains pure string and metadata logic only.
